retrievalProfile.description: A dark, textured nocturnal scene featuring a central red starburst illuminating clouds, topped by ornate, high-contrast Spencerian calligraphy with extensive swashes.
triggerTerms: Spencerian swash typography on black background

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast composition where a singular red light source pierces through dark, billowy clouds against a textured black void, anchored by a top-centered block of intricate, flowing script with symmetrical flourishes.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical hierarchy with text at the top and imagery centered below
Color contrast between deep blacks, blood reds, and cream-colored text
Interaction between the rigid starburst rays and the organic, swirling calligraphic lines
Textured grain throughout the dark space suggesting vintage print quality
coreInvariants: Elaborate calligraphic swashes that extend horizontally

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Text is positioned in the upper third; the starburst and clouds occupy the center and lower-middle sections.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright red point of the starburst acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the ornate text, follows the vertical axis down to the starburst, and then radiates outward through the clouds.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space surrounds the central elements, creating a sense of vastness.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black and charcoal grey providing a textured background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant crimson and ruby red for the clouds and starburst.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cream or off-white for the typography to ensure legibility against the dark void.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the text and background; high saturation in the red focal point fading into dark shadows.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Uppercase initials feature massive, spiraling swashes that underline the entire word block
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single ornate script style used for all text elements to maintain elegance.

preserve: The horizontal span of the flourishes

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the high-contrast calligraphic feel and elegant loops.
Provides the necessary swash alternates for a similar ornate look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dark, grainy night sky with a central red starburst illuminating a cluster of dark, textured clouds. The overall mood should be 1970s analog photography.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply custom Spencerian lettering in cream at the top center, ensuring the flourishes are symmetrical and expansive.

verificationChecks: Is the starburst the brightest point in the image?
Do the calligraphic flourishes extend beyond the width of the letterforms?
Is there a visible film grain or paper texture across the black areas?

mustRedesign: Exact wording of the original title
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible despite the flourishes
Check that the red color doesn't bleed into the cream text
Verify the composition feels vertically balanced
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a dark celestial photograph with a high-contrast Spencerian script header to create a 70s-inspired dramatic layout.
